request.compressed_layers_true: store the upstream layer bytes verbatim under the layer entry
request.compressed_layers_false: store the decompressed layer tar under the layer entry

storage: bounded per-layer temporary spool; the complete archive is never persisted
post_commit_failure: abort downstream transport without tar terminator
shared_layer: validate every config diff_id before writing one layer entry
tag_case: preserve tag verbatim in manifest path and RepoTags while normalizing registry/repository
